title: China-to-Kenya Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety, PVoC, and Voltage Scope
rows.target_requirement: Kenya applies KEBS Pre-export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) routes for in-scope regulated electrical products. The practical baseline is a Kenya-aligned safety path based on KS IEC 62841 and related technical documents; evidence should be mapped to the marketed model, the required marking path (including Standardization/Import Standardization Mark and Certificate of Conformity), and Kenya grid assumptions of 240 V, 50 Hz. China files typically test against GB/GBT electrical standards and may rely on GB/T or CCC marks, which do not replace KEBS PVoC outcomes.
target_standards: KEBS PVoC regime for regulated electrical goods
Kenya import Certificate of Conformity procedures
KS IEC 62841 (Kenya-adopted safety pathway aligned with IEC)
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly references GB/GBT electrical safety series for power tools, and some products also rely on CCC evidence where applicable. This is often treated as the principal electrical baseline in China, but Kenya entry requires explicit KEBS PVoC scope and mark handling.
china_standards: GB/T/GB standards for power tools where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent gap is treating a China domestic electrical safety package as export-compliant for Kenya. The importer file should distinguish tool body, charger, and power module, map the exact Kenyan model and frequency/voltage profile, and retain PVoC/CoC and required mark evidence.

target.en: Mandatory for regulated models: KEBS PVoC scope determination, Certificate of Conformity, and the required marking route. KS IEC 62841 is the technical evidence path used through Kenya standards alignment; KEBS confirmation is not optional.
target.zh: 受管制型号的强制性要求：KEBS PVoC范围判定、符合性证书（CoC）和要求的标志路径。KS IEC 62841是通过肯尼亚对齐的技术证据路线，KEBS确认不是可选项。
target.zht: 受管制型號的強制性要求：KEBS PVoC範圍判定、符合性證書（CoC）和要求的標誌路徑。KS IEC 62841是透過肯亞對齊的技術證據路線，KEBS確認不是可選項。

cn.en: China commonly uses GB/GBT and CCC routes for tool safety, which do not replace KEBS import conformity confirmation.
cn.zh: 中国常用GB/GBT和CCC路线处理工具安全，但不替代KEBS进口符合性确认。
cn.zht: 中國常用GB/GBT和CCC路線處理工具安全，但不替代KEBS進口符合性確認。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Kenya-ready until electrical safety evidence is structured under KEBS PVoC scope, with model-level 240 V/50 Hz handling and confirmed Certificate of Conformity and mark requirements.

rows.requirement: EMC and Radio Approval for Cordless Tools
rows.target_requirement: Kenya does not rely on a broad single EMC mark for all power tools. For tools with radio transmitters (for example Bluetooth or similar cordless connectivity), Communications Authority of Kenya approval is the practical radio gate; non-radio EMC effects are handled through product safety and technical evidence in the KEBS process. No EU-style standalone EMC noise-style or CE-style universal mandatory EMC mark is generally confirmed as a separate market-access condition for all Kenyan power tools.
target_standards: Communication and radio requirements administered by Communications Authority of Kenya
KEBS technical safety and conformity framework
No confirmed mandatory EU-style standalone EMC product mark for all power tools in Kenya
rows.china_equivalent: China often maps EMC through GB/T or equivalent IEC routes and radio modules through SRRC-related pathways. Those domestic files can support technical review but do not replace Kenya CA checks where a radio transmitter is part of the cordless tool.
china_standards: GB/T EMC and radio test references
rows.gap: A common gap is assuming domestic EMC or SRRC-type approval covers Kenya import readiness. The practical gap is adding specific CA radio handling for cordless models while keeping EMC scope aligned to the marketed kit and not relying on a China-only report for Kenya entry.

target.en: Mandatory requirement: CA radio compliance path when radio transmission is present in the cordless product. No confirmed EU-style standalone EMC mandatory mark is reported for all power tools; EMC is handled within applicable safety and conformity evidence.
target.zh: 强制要求：无绳工具若包含无线发射功能，需执行CA无线电合规路径。未确认所有电动工具都受欧盟式独立EMC强制标志约束；EMC通常随相关安全与符合性证据处理。
target.zht: 強制要求：無繩工具若包含無線發射功能，需履行CA無線電合規路徑。未確認所有電動工具都受歐盟式獨立EMC強制標誌約束；EMC通常隨相關安全與符合性證據處理。

cn.en: China EMC and SRRC evidence is useful for technical comparison but is not a standalone Kenya radio-entry substitute.
cn.zh: 中国EMC与SRRC证据可用于技术比较，但不足以替代肯尼亚无线电入门槛。
cn.zht: 中國EMC與SRRC證據可用於技術比較，但不足以替代肯尼亞無線電入門檻。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Kenya-ready until cordless products with transmitters are routed through the appropriate CA approval path and all marketed configurations are covered in the technical file for Kenya entry.

rows.requirement: Market Access, Importer, and Import Marks
rows.target_requirement: Kenya market entry for regulated power tools is handled through KEBS PVoC and importer-side customs execution. A valid Kenya-compliant package should include a valid Certificate of Conformity, required Standardization/Import Standardization Mark handling, and an importer flow that reflects port processing via Mombasa. Workplace safety effects related to noise and exposure are addressed through DOSHS at workplace usage level, while power-tool market conformity remains a KEBS gate.
target_standards: Standardization and Import Standardization Mark rules
Port of entry coordination via Mombasa
rows.china_equivalent: China export practice generally relies on export documents plus domestic certification packages. Kenya requires a Kenya-specific import conformity path and entry flow, so local CoC and import-mark handling are not automatic from China documents.
rows.gap: The main practical gap is treating China export closure as final. Import readiness for Kenya requires KEBS PVoC routing, mark handling, and Mombasa customs execution with the right local importer pathway for the sold model.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: KEBS PVoC import conformity, Certificate of Conformity issuance where applicable, and required Standardization/Import Standardization Mark workflow through the local importer and Mombasa entry process.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：KEBS PVoC进口符合性、适用时的符合性证书出具，以及通过本地进口商和蒙巴萨入境流程完成标准化/进口标准化标志要求。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：KEBS PVoC進口符合性、適用時的符合性證書出具，以及透過本地進口商和蒙巴薩入境流程完成標準化/進口標準化標誌要求。

cn.en: Chinese domestic export documentation and CCC/GBT reports remain useful evidence, but they are not a substitute for Kenya import conformity evidence.
cn.zh: 中国的国内出口文件及CCC/GBT报告仍可作为有用证据，但不能替代肯尼亚进口符合性证据。
cn.zht: 中國的國內出口文件及CCC/GBT報告仍可作為有用證據，但不能替代肯尼亞進口符合性證據。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Kenya-ready until KEBS PVoC, CoC, marking, and importer/port execution for Mombasa are complete and documented for the exact exported model.

rows.target_requirement: No EU-style mandatory outdoor noise marking regime is confirmed as a general product-entry condition for Kenya power tools. In practice, occupational exposure and noise-management obligations are handled through workplace and safety regimes, including Kenya DOSHS expectations, while tool-level noise labels are not presented as a single Kenya CE-like entry requirement.
target_standards: DOSHS workplace noise and exposure requirements in workplace settings
No confirmed Kenya-wide mandatory EU-style power-tool outdoor noise-marking regime
rows.china_equivalent: China noise handling for power tools is commonly through GB/T noise test practice and workplace exposure limits, not an automatic country-level mandatory noise label route. This is broadly comparable to the practical gap position in Kenya.
china_standards: GB/T noise test methods for relevant products
rows.gap: The honest gap is that an EU-style outdoor-noise certificate should not be treated as a Kenyan requirement in the same way. The gap is to keep honest evidence for exported products and avoid asserting a non-existent Kenya-wide mandatory noise mark as mandatory.

target.en: No confirmed EU-style mandatory outdoor noise mark is in scope as a Kenya product-entry condition for power tools.
target.zh: 对肯尼亚电动工具，未确认有欧盟式户外噪声标志强制作为入市条件。
target.zht: 對肯尼亞電動工具，未確認有歐盟式戶外噪聲標誌強制作為入市條件。

cn.en: China does not rely on a single mandatory noise-product mark for power tools either, so this is primarily a mapping and claims-quality gap.
cn.zh: 中国也不依赖单一强制性工具级噪声标志，因此这里主要是证据映射与宣称表述差距。
cn.zht: 中國也不依賴單一強制性工具級噪聲標誌，因此這裡主要是證據映射與宣稱表述差距。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not applicable as a mandatory Kenya-wide product noise-marking check; EU-style outdoor-noise evidence should not be presented as a direct legal entry requirement in Kenya.

source.publisher: Directorate of Occupational Safety and Health Services

rows.requirement: Restricted Substances and RoHS-like Horizontal Regime
rows.target_requirement: Kenya has not confirmed an EU-style horizontal RoHS-like mandatory regime as a single entry gate for power tools. Substance control is therefore generally managed through sectoral, project, procurement, and general environmental pathways rather than one mandatory national product declaration replacing the KEBS route.
target_standards: Environmental and procurement controls applied through sectoral and workplace channels in Kenya
No confirmed single national RoHS-like mandatory horizontal power-tool statute
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly uses RoHS and GB/T substance documentation for electrical products. Those documents may still be relevant for customer or ecosystem expectations, but they do not create a confirmed Kenya EU-style horizontal legal substitution.
rows.gap: The clear gap is overclaiming this as a mandatory, one-step Kenya legal gate. The practical position is to treat Kenya as no confirmed standalone national restricted-substances regime for power tools and avoid mapping EU-style RoHS declarations as mandatory in-country obligations.

target.en: No confirmed single mandatory Kenya-wide RoHS-style horizontal regime for power-tool market entry. Claims should reflect sectoral and procurement reality instead of a universal law-style declaration.
target.zh: 未确认肯尼亚存在单一全国性RoHS式横向入场强制制度。要求表述应反映行业与采购现实，而非普遍法条式声明。
target.zht: 未確認肯尼亞存在單一全國性RoHS式橫向入場強制制度。要求表述應反映行業與採購現實，而非普遍法條式聲明。

cn.en: China material evidence and CCC support technical review, but do not create a Kenya-wide mandatory substances substitute.
cn.zh: 中国材料证据和CCC可支持技术审查，但不能替代肯尼亚全国性强制物质要求。
cn.zht: 中國材料證據和CCC可支援技術審查，但不能取代肯尼亞全國性強制物質要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No confirmed Kenya-wide mandatory RoHS-style power-tool gate; present substance controls as evidence for buyer, environmental, and sectoral expectations rather than a universal Kenya legal declaration requirement.

rows.requirement: Cordless Tool Battery Compliance in Kenya
rows.target_requirement: No confirmed Kenya EU-style dedicated battery regulation equivalent is visible as a single product-level entry condition for power-tool batteries in the same way as EU battery legislation. Kenya obligations are treated through the broader KEBS PVoC/import-safety path, transport safety handling where relevant, and model-specific product requirements; no universal national battery passport or removability checklist is confirmed as mandatory in-country gate for all power-tool batteries.
target_standards: KEBS PVoC and related import conformity pathway
Dangerous-goods transport requirements where lithium batteries are supplied
Model-specific product safety evidence in Kenya
rows.china_equivalent: China filings commonly provide RoHS-style battery documents, GB/T or CCC-linked battery safety evidence, and transport evidence for lithium batteries. These are useful, but they should not be represented as meeting a mandatory Kenya standalone battery law gate.
china_standards: GB/GBT battery safety and transport references
rows.gap: The key gap is assuming EU-style battery obligations (passport, economic-operator duties, or removability law) apply in Kenya as a direct mandatory package. Kenya practice appears to evaluate the battery as part of the product-safety/import process rather than through a confirmed standalone battery regime.

target.en: No confirmed mandatory Kenya-wide standalone battery-entry regime equivalent to the EU battery law structure is established in this lane. Battery evidence should align with KEBS import conformity and transport-safety outcomes when triggered.
target.zh: 本路线未确认肯尼亚存在欧盟电池法结构下的全国性独立电池入场制度。电池证据应与KEBS进口符合性及触发时的运输安全结果对齐。
target.zht: 本路線未確認肯尼亞存在歐盟電池法結構下的全國性獨立電池入場制度。電池證據應與KEBS進口符合性及觸發時的運輸安全結果對齊。

cn.en: Chinese battery evidence is useful but should be used to support technical review and commercial expectations, not as a standalone legal pass in Kenya.
cn.zh: 中国电池证据有参考价值，但应用于技术审查和商业预期支撑，而非作为肯尼亚单一法定通行证。
cn.zht: 中國電池證據有參考價值，但應用於技術審查和商業預期支撐，而非作為肯尼亞單一法定通行證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No single EU-style Kenya-wide battery-entry regime appears confirmed; do not present battery passport language as mandatory for all Kenya power-tool battery packs.
